chunks.heading: WrymWretch

chunks.heading: WrymWretch

chunks.heading: Seraphyne hesitated. "Already fading."

chunks.heading: I… remember… me…
chunks.notes: Act I closes on the first seal cracking; Act II opens with Thalen beside Sylvan, feeling the dragon's heartbeat match his own and knowing "he was different" -- the bond is present but not yet named.

chunks.heading: I… remember… me…
chunks.notes: Sylvan's direct declaration -- "You were born when I was born... You are my other half" -- is the explicit twin-bond reveal for this pair.

chunks.heading: He swallowed hard. "And the rot?"
chunks.notes: Sylvan ties the bond to survival ("if memory dies... so do we") and states "the others are awakening," setting up the convergence of pairs.

chunks.heading: Thalen stood, heart pounding. "Then we must go."
chunks.notes: Aeris's bond with Aetherius locks into place ("You're real... We were born together"), mirroring Thalen's scene for a new pair.

chunks.heading: Kael nodded. "Then we hunt the Remnants."

chunks.heading: Seraphyne's breath trembled. "Then we must go."
chunks.notes: The explicit convergence line -- "six dragons and six elves moved toward the same place... Toward #Wrymreach" -- plus the abyss described as birthplace/threshold of their kind.

chunks.heading: I… remember… me…

chunks.heading: I… remember… me…

chunks.heading: I… remember… me…

chunks.heading: Chapter Two — The Princess on the Shore

chunks.heading: Chapter Two — The Princess on the Shore

chunks.heading: Alexi blinked. "Tea has a lord."
chunks.notes: The princess's warning about her father's debts and the "Lord of Tea" setting his eyes on the ocean introduces the institutional-greed threat plainly stated in this chunk.

chunks.heading: Alexi blinked. "Tea has a lord."

chunks.heading: Alexi blinked. "Tea has a lord."
